scheme_name: Gopinath Munde Shetkari Apghat Suraksha Sanugrah Anudan Yojana
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra
summary: Accident compensation scheme providing financial assistance to farmer families in Maharashtra in case of accidental death or disability of the farmer.
benefits: Lump-sum ex-gratia compensation to the farmer's nominee/family in case of accidental death or permanent disability.
eligibility: Farmers registered in Maharashtra land records (7/12 extract) aged 10-75 years
application_steps: Submit claim through Taluka Agriculture Officer within the prescribed period
